sources.entry: InputSourcePro - Tool for automatically switching input sources by app or website. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/runjuu/InputSourcePro) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Input Source Pro
summary.one_liner: A macOS utility that automatically switches keyboard input sources based on the active app or website, with an on-screen indicator and custom shortcuts.
use_cases: Automatically switch keyboard language when changing apps
Set a default keyboard for each app
Switch keyboard layout per website in a browser
Keep English punctuation while coding in IDEs or terminals
Switch input sources with modifier-key taps
summary.what_it_does: Automatically switches input sources based on the active application or website, and supports all macOS applications according to the page. Browser website-based switching is listed for Safari, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Vivaldi, and Arc. A tooltip shows the current keyboard, shown on long-press of the left mouse button, on keyboard switch, and/or on app switch. It can force English punctuation in specific apps such as IDEs or terminals, toggle standard F-keys versus media keys per app, and switch sources using custom shortcuts or single or combined modifier-key taps.
notable: Per-app and per-website input source switching, including browsers like Safari, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Vivaldi, and Arc
Forces English punctuation in IDEs and terminals
Open source, per the awesome-mac listing
caveats: Platform support is macOS only, per the page
Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware and open source
